officialInventory.summary: Wildlife protected areas are designated under the Biodiversity/Wildlife Act 2003 and managed by the Department of Parks and Wildlife Management (DPWM); forest reserves/parks are under the Department of Forestry. The best official list found is Table 1 'Protected Areas of the Gambia' in the revised NBSAP (March 2015), giving 22 entries (7 established parks/reserves, 1 proposed national park, 1 community wildlife reserve and 13 community conservation areas then 'in process'). The 6th national report (2019) repeats the count of 22 wildlife protected areas (8 reserves/national parks + 14 community-based conservation areas) without names. No DPWM-published list was used (dpwm.gov.gm reported hijacked/dead).

statedCounts.quote: Currently there are (22) wildlife Protected Areas, occupying a total area of 76,064 hectares, approximately 6.4% of Gambia's total surface area.
Eight of these Protected Areas are reserves and national parks while 14 are community based conservation areas under the mandate of the Department of Parks and Wildlife (DPWM).
14 are community based conservation areas under the mandate of the Department of Parks and Wildlife (DPWM)
There are 66 forest reserves covering a total of 34,029 hectares managed by the Department of Forestry.

areas.name: Abuko Nature Reserve
areas.notes: 134 ha; 'The first Protected area in the Gambia' (NBSAP 2015).

areas.name: Kiang West National Park
areas.notes: 19,051 ha 'This includes the Extension' (NBSAP 2015).

areas.name: Niumi National Park
areas.notes: 7,758 ha. NR6 calls it one of 'the Gambia’s marine PAs'. Part of the transboundary Niumi–Saloum Delta Ramsar site (handled separately).

areas.name: Bao Bolong Wetland Reserve
areas.notes: Spelled 'Boa Bolong Wetland Reserve' in the NBSAP table: established 1993, 22,000 ha, 'Was designated a RAMSAR site in 1996'.

areas.name: Tanji Bird Reserve
areas.notes: 612 ha. NBSAP lists it among coastal habitats under protection.

areas.name: Tanbi Wetland National Park
areas.notes: 6,034 ha; establishment date blank in NBSAP table. NR6 calls it one of 'the Gambia’s marine PAs'. Ramsar date differs between NBSAP (December 2002) and NR7 (2007).

areas.name: River Gambia National Park
areas.notes: 589 ha; 'managed as a project' (NBSAP 2015).

areas.name: Jokadou National Park
areas.notes: 15,028 ha, 'In process of designation … Proposed' (NBSAP 2015). NR6 (2019) counts 8 reserves/national parks, which could include it, but no designation was verified.

areas.name: Bolong Fenyo Community Wildlife Reserve
areas.notes: 320 ha; 'The first community owned reserve' (NBSAP 2015).

areas.name: Bamako Community Conservation Area
areas.notes: 1,032 ha. 'In process' in NBSAP 2015; NR6 (2019) reports DPWM 'managed to establish thirteen new community protected areas' and counts 14 community-based conservation areas, consistent with the 13 'in process' CCAs plus Bolong Fenyo, but NR6 does not name them — formal status unverified.

notEnumerated.category: forest reserves / forest parks (Department of Forestry)
notEnumerated.reason: No official list found; NBSAP gives 66 forest reserves (34,029 ha), of which 34 forest parks (22,239 ha) designated as protected forest; NBSAP notes most are not categorised as protected areas, except e.g. Bijilo, Pirang, Kungkilling and Dobo which are 'managed for conservation'.

notEnumerated.category: community forests and joint forest parks
notEnumerated.reason: NR6 mentions 29 community forests and 23 joint forest parks; no list found.

gaps: No legal instrument (gazette notice) was verified for any Gambian protected area; establishment years come from the NBSAP table.
The status of the 13 community conservation areas listed 'in process' in 2015 is inferred, not confirmed by name, from NR6's statement that 13 new community protected areas were established.
NR7 (2026) mentions 'new site designations' without naming them; any post-2019 designations (e.g. Jokadu NP, Kartong MPA) remain unverified.
The Biodiversity and Wildlife Act 2003 text (and any schedule of protected areas) was not located in FAOLEX during this run.
